page_title: BAY 2-1 DOR | Bayern Munich v Dortmund 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+5' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
90+4' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 12:17.
90+3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) launches a cross from the corner, but Manuel Neuer is alert to thwart the effort.
90+2' Substitution. Aleksandar Pavlovic is replaced by Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich).
90+2' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Good work from Dortmund as they win a corner.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' The rebound from the corner kick falls to Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund), who fires in a missile of a shot from long range, but it goes miles wide of the right post.
90' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

89' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner.
89' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
88' This shall not pass! Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
87' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) produces a killer pass onto Maximilian Beier, who loses the ball to one of the defenders.
86' A great run by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) gets him into the box, but his powerful shot is bravely blocked by a defender.

84' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Julian Ryerson. The score is now 2:1.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Sacha Boey.
84' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Fabio Silva (Dortmund) replaces Serhou Guirassy.
84' Pascal Gross goes off the pitch and Julian Brandt (Dortmund) comes on.
83' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Dortmund.
82' The ball is cleared after Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
78' 2 - 0 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 2:0.
77' The attendance is 75000.
77' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle as Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
76' Gregor Kobel leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich).

76' Luis Diaz receives a sweet cross inside the box from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
75' Referee Bastian Dankert halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Niko Kovac, then shows him a yellow.
74' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Karim Adeyemi and he is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
73' The substitution has been made. Jobe Bellingham (Dortmund) has replaced Marcel Sabitzer.
72' Michael Olise nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
71' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.

68' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the right post.
67' 11:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 5:0.
65' Serhou Guirassy plays a short pass through to Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post.
64' It could have been a good chance to score! Pascal Gross (Dortmund) fails to release Serhou Guirassy with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
62' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
61' Here is a change. Nicolas Jackson is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich).
60' A player from Bayern Munich commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
59' Daniel Svensson picks out Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) unmarked inside the box, but he blazes the ball well over the bar.
58' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
55' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Pascal Gross (Dortmund) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
53' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

52' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
52' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
50' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
50' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) threads a pass through to Serhou Guirassy, but Manuel Neuer breaks up the move.
49' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) latches onto the free kick from Julian Ryerson, but heads just wide of the left post from close range.
48' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
46' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
46' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
46' Niko Kovac has made a change at the break. Ramy Bensebaini has come on in place of Niklas Sule (Dortmund).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Waldemar Anton (Dortmund) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
42' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared to safety by the defence.

40' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Gregor Kobel was alert and made an astonishing save!

38' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle after Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Dortmund, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
36' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
35' A wild effort from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
33' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
32' Golden opportunity! Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:0. The shots on goal statistics – 4:0.
31' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
30' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
28' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Dortmund are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

25' A perfect long pass by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) finds Julian Ryerson. He latches on to the pass and continues his attacking run. Good movement by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.

22' 1 - 0 Joshua Kimmich sends in a great cross from the corner and finds Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who outjumps the defence to put the ball into the roof of the net with a stunning header. The score is 1:0.
21' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is about to take a corner kick.
21' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) sprays a pass out to Nicolas Jackson, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball. Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
20' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
18' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
17' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Dortmund.
16' 83:17 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
14' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Dortmund will have a goal kick.

11' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the left-hand post, but Gregor Kobel was alert and the score remains the same. Gregor Kobel makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target.
7' Some patient build-up play from Bayern Munich as they look to unlock the defence.
5' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempts to release Serhou Guirassy with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

4' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Gregor Kobel! It will be a corner kick for Bayern Munich.
3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Neuer comes off his line to gather the ball.
3' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
2' Bayern Munich hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
